abstract: Teratocarcinosarcoma, although a rare neoplastic entity, should be considered as a differential diagnosis in any middle-aged adult presenting with a history of intermittent unilateral epistaxis and nasal obstruction. Tissue biopsy may fail to reveal a full spectrum of histologic heterogeneity in these tumours, and definitive diagnosis is usually made with tumour resection. Aggressive treatment including surgery followed by adjuvant radiation therapy is advocated and confers a better rate of survival than radiotherapy alone. Our current report is unique in two respects. First, disease recurrence is usually manifested very early on, leading some authors to conclude that a neoplastic-free interval of 3 years or longer probably indicates a good chance of being cured. Our patient, in contrast, experienced a disease-free interval of 4 years before evidence of recurrence emerged. Second, intracranial extension with brain parenchymal involvement has not been previously reported despite the tumour's proximity to the anterior cranial fossa and its locally aggressive behaviour with frequent bony invasion. Despite intracranial invasion, our patient experienced a long disease-free interval. As such, even advanced disease should be treated aggressively.
abstract_ja: 奇形癌肉腫は稀な腫瘍性疾患ですが、間欠的な片側性鼻出血と鼻閉を訴える中年成人では鑑別診断として考慮すべきです。組織生検では、これらの腫瘍の組織学的な多様性の全容が捉えられないことがあり、確定診断は通常、腫瘍切除によって得られます。手術に続く補助放射線療法を含む積極的な治療が推奨されており、放射線療法単独よりも良好な生存率をもたらします。本報告は2つの点で特異的です。第一に、この疾患の再発は通常きわめて早期に現れるため、一部の著者は3年以上の無腫瘍期間があれば治癒の可能性が高いと結論づけています。これに対し、本症例では4年の無病期間を経て再発が認められました。第二に、前頭蓋窩への近接性と、骨浸潤を頻繁に伴う局所浸潤性の強い性質にもかかわらず、脳実質浸潤を伴う頭蓋内進展はこれまで報告されていません。頭蓋内浸潤があったにもかかわらず、本患者は長期間の無病期間を経過しました。したがって、進行した疾患であっても積極的に治療すべきです。
